source: e-0055: is e-0054's structurally-available pi_mid POWERABLE on the held-out eval split?
method: Tag each of the 633 canonical wide targets with e-0054 named-nesting-depth from data/deep have-trees; apply e-0046 area-stratified module-disjoint every-5th-module holdout; count contrast-carrying targets per side; discount eval side by e-0028 per-area round-trip yield; compare eval verified carriers to McNemar's exact D>=6 power floor (e-0045).
headline: CONTRA the corpus_v3 precedent: e-0054's structurally-available pi_mid SURVIVES the held-out eval split too. The standard e-0046 area-stratified module-disjoint every-5th-module holdout lands 80 of the 633 targets' intermediate-cut (depth>=2) carriers in the eval slice, ~70.4 after the e-0028 yield discount -- ~12x McNemar's D=6 power floor and ~60% of the binary route's own ~115.8 eval n (e-0046). Even the 4-level contrast (depth>=3) keeps 17 eval carriers (~15.3 verified), still clearing the floor. So the deep pivot reopens q-0005 BOTH structurally (e-0054) AND statistically (e-0055): a 3-level rough/mid/fine U-shape is power-RESOLVABLE on the existing holdout -- unlike corpus_v3's binary contrast which was power-EXACTLY-0 at D=5 (e-0045). The remaining gates on the 3rd arm are therefore NOT eval power but (1) construct validity of pi_mid vs mere format (e-0036/e-0037, needs the off-disk residual body) and (2) the ~1.5x compute of a 3rd adapter+arm (a-0054), which the 2-arm cost chain (e-0048/e-0052) never priced. q-0005's 'binary' verdict is overturned for the deep route on supply grounds; whether mid is a DISTINCT granularity is the next (paid) gate, not a power problem.
CAVEAT: Eval 'verified' is the e-0028 per-area COUNT projection, not a real round-trip (needs the Modal pass); it projects supply not pass@k. The McNemar D>=6 floor (e-0045) bounds the discordant pairs, and verified carriers UPPER-bound the discordant total, so eval_verified < 6 => power EXACTLY 0; eval_verified >= 6 is NECESSARY not sufficient (the discordant subset is smaller still, and construct-validity of pi_mid vs format -- e-0036/e-0037 -- is a separate unmet gate). Depth is a STRUCTURAL count; whether each named frontier carries distinct granularity signal needs the off-disk residual body.
